newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Formosa 1996 pre-tax profit up 0.92 pct.
newsitem.headline: Formosa 1996 pre-tax profit up 0.92 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Formosa Plastics Corp is one of the world's largest polyvinyl chloride (PVC) makers and head of the Formosa Plastics group.
Late on Tuesday Formosa's board proposed a 1997 dividend of T$1.80 per share, comprising T$0.90 per share in cash and T$0.90 per share in a stock, or bonus issue, the firm said in a statement.
The company set a 1997 pre-tax profit target of T$6.752 billion, down 6.8 percent from 1996, and a 1997 sales target of T$39.171 billion, up 7.8 percent from year ago.

Formosa plans to issue T$8 billion in corporate bonds to pay back short-term loans, but gave no issue date. The term will be less than seven years and the coupon rate lower than 7.0 percent in principle, it said.
All of the proposals need final shareholder approval at a meeting slated for May 6, the statement said.
